usage: Java Thymeleaf/Spring page templates, one DNA each.

java_pages.title: Newsroom Blog Index (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Newsroom-wire blog index: datelined masthead, edition bar, article rows with kickers and bylines — a front page, not a card grid.

java_pages.title: Lab Changelog (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Laboratory-clean release log: version rows with oversized ghost numerals, mono type badges, dated entries with honest notes.

java_pages.title: Solar Docs with Margin Notes (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Warm solarized documentation page: sticky section sidebar, Source Serif prose, and a margin-notes column for asides on wide screens.

java_pages.title: Brutalist Bento Features (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Asymmetric industrial bento for a site builder: one huge type tile, staggered feature tiles with hard offset shadows and mono spec labels.

java_pages.title: Swiss Airline Footer (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Swiss-airline footer as a full page: red-rule sitemap columns, departure-board mono clock, and an oversized outlined wordmark.

java_pages.title: Constructivist Hero (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Offset split hero for a freight brokerage: giant Russo One headline over a diagonal red beam, vertical mono waybill label, single primary action.

java_pages.title: Midnight Railway Login (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Dark midnight-railway sign-in: offset ticket-stub card with perforated edge, brass accents, platform-board mono labels.

java_pages.title: Reading-Room Pricing Ledger (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Dark library-oak pricing as a ruled ledger table: three plans as rows with brass rules, stamped recommendation, honest footnotes.

java_pages.title: Terminal Stats Readout (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Retro-terminal company stats: a typed ./report command, amber values on phosphor green, blinking block cursor, scanline texture.

java_pages.title: Reader-Letter Testimonial (Java/Thymeleaf)
java_pages.description: Single-statement zine testimonial: giant Anton pull-quote on pasted paper, rotated red rubber-stamp mark, typewriter caption.
